On May 18,19, 2021, Venus Protocol on BNB Chain accumulated more than $100 million in protocol bad debt after XVS token price was manipulated on Binance. Manipulators used inflated XVS collateral to borrow substantial BTC and ETH, and the system's liquidation process could not recover these assets after XVS crashed. Venus Protocol's price oracle sourced XVS value exclusively from Binance's illiquid spot market, allowing an actor to pump XVS price, borrow heavily against inflated collateral, and leave unrecoverable bad debt when the price collapsed. No aggregation, TWAP, or circuit-breaker prevented the exploit.
